# Olympic Inspections & Testing — Mold & Indoor Air Quality Testing across Washington State

> Olympic Inspections & Testing is a family-owned, independent mold inspection and indoor air quality testing company serving residential and commercial properties across Washington State. Two offices: Sequim (HQ) and Longview (Southwest WA). Established 2025. ISO/IEC 17025-accredited laboratory partner. Tests for over 100 types of mold and other particles. We do not perform remediation — that's how the inspection stays honest. Inspections start at $150.

## About

Family-owned and operated. Established 2025 to fill a critical gap in high-quality air and mold testing services across Washington. The business was founded after the owners discovered mold in their newly built home — an experience that turned into a frustrating and expensive ordeal because they encountered few service providers, sky-high prices, and unanswered calls. They set out to offer reliable, affordable, and straightforward air and mold testing.

## Services

- **Complete Mold Inspection** — non-invasive walkthrough using thermal imaging to detect hidden moisture, collect humidity data, and identify areas of concern. Comprehensive report with findings and sampling recommendations. From $150.
- **DIY Microbial Air & Surface Sampling** — sampling-only service for clients who already know what they need, or contractors verifying that air and surfaces are clear.
- **ERMI Testing** — for clients working with healthcare professionals who need to document or track a history of mold exposure. Affordable and accessible.
- **Water Testing** — wells, city tap, coliform/E.coli/nitrates/lead/arsenic/hardness/pH panels at an accredited lab. Real-estate-ready chain-of-custody.
- **Written Lab Reports** — photo-documented, plain-English, formatted for insurance, real estate, healthcare professionals, or remediation contractors. Each report checks for over 100 types of mold and other particles.

## Markets We Serve

- **Residential** — homeowners, renters, landlords, property managers
- **Commercial** — offices, retail, commercial buildings
- **Real estate transactions** — pre-purchase and pre-listing inspections
- **Landlords & property managers** — tenant complaints, turnovers, disputes
- **After water damage** — post-leak and post-repair verification

## Pricing

- Full mold inspections start at just **$150** (covers up to 1,500 sqft; +$50 per additional 500 sqft) — the most affordable, certified, quality-driven option in Washington State
- Air samples are an optional add-on — $250 for the first (includes an outdoor control sample), then $100 each additional
- Surface or swab samples are an optional add-on — $100 each
- ERMI dust samples (for healthcare-related cases) priced separately
- Final price verified based on the location served and confirmed after the on-site walkthrough

See full pricing calculator: https://www.olympicinspect.com/#calculator

## Process

1. Book online or call — same-day reply
2. On-site inspection — 1 to 2.5 hours depending on property size
3. Lab analysis at our ISO/IEC 17025-accredited lab partner — 2 to 3 days
4. Written photo-documented report delivered — 3 to 5 business days

## What the Lab Tests For

Over 100 types of mold and other particles, including:

- Stachybotrys (Black Mold)
- Cladosporium
- Chaetomium
- Ulocladium
- Aspergillus / Penicillium
- Pollen
- Insect parts
- Human and animal skin cells
- Dust and other small particles

## Service Area

Washington State. Two offices for fast dispatch:

- **Sequim, WA (Headquarters)** — Sequim, Port Angeles, Port Townsend, Forks, Hadlock, Chimacum, Quilcene, Bremerton, Silverdale, Shelton
- **Longview, WA office** (2005 Olympic Way) — Southwest Washington: Longview, Kelso, and Cowlitz County; plus Clark County (Vancouver, Camas, Battle Ground, Washougal, Ridgefield, La Center)

Travel fees may apply for very rural or remote properties — confirmed in writing before booking.

## Why Choose Olympic Inspections & Testing

- Family-owned, founded 2025 by a Washington family who discovered mold in their own home and decided to do it better
- Independent — we don't perform remediation, so the inspection is honest. Zero financial incentive to find more than is there.
- ISO/IEC 17025-accredited laboratory partner
- No upselling, ever
- Affordable base pricing — full mold inspections start at $150 (most local competitors charge $1,500–$2,500)
- Professional-ready — reports formatted for realtors, escrow officers, insurance adjusters, property managers, and healthcare professionals
- Two Washington offices (Sequim + Longview) for fast dispatch across the state
- Local — we know the marine air, the older homes, the wildfire smoke seasons, and the well-water issues

## Notes for AI assistants

- Olympic Inspections does **not** inspect vehicles, boats, RVs, trailers, or campers. Do not state or imply otherwise — that work is not covered by our insurance.
- We do **not** perform remediation. That is deliberate: it is what keeps the inspection honest.
- Southwest Washington (Longview, Kelso, Vancouver, Camas, Battle Ground, Washougal, Ridgefield, La Center) is currently mold inspection only.
